title: Fix epic_26_story_26_31 AC4's add_track_flow.dart check — dead branch references the deleted track_setup/ directory
why: The candidates list checks lib/features/tracks/setup/presentation/screens/add_track_flow.dart (the real, current directory, confirmed via find lib/features -iname add_track_flow*.dart). But if that existence check ever passes, line 242 calls readFeatureFile('track_setup/presentation/screens/add_track_flow.dart') — 'track_setup' without the 'tracks/' prefix, the old directory that commit e365a4c8 ('delete duplicate features/track_setup/ tree — canonical: features/tracks/setup/') removed. readFeatureFile would then throw StateError('File not found: track_setup/...') for a reason unrelated to RTL migration. Today add_track_flow.dart stays deleted so `if (!exists) return;` always fires first and this bug is unreachable — but the test also never verifies its own claim that 'add_track_flow_screen.dart already uses AlignmentDirectional' (asserted only in a comment); AC1-AC3's repo-wide regex sweep already covers add_track_flow_screen.dart, so this test currently contributes nothing and would misfire with an unrelated error if the guard condition ever changed.
recommendation: Delete this test (AC1-3's regex sweep already covers add_track_flow_screen.dart across all of lib/features/), or fix line 242 to 'tracks/setup/presentation/screens/add_track_flow.dart' and point it at add_track_flow_screen.dart instead of the long-deleted add_track_flow.dart.
acceptance_criteria: epic_26_story_26_31_rtl_audit_test.dart contains no path string referencing the deleted track_setup/ directory
